modmenu.descriptionTranslation.shhh-mob-: An upgraded mob health indicator mod with multiple visual presets, RPG tiered hearts, and comprehensive mob category filtering.
shhh-mob-health-indicators.config.title: Shhh Mob Health Indicators Settings
shhh-mob-health-indicators.tooltip.enabl: Master switch to turn all mob health indicators ON or OFF.
shhh-mob-health-indicators.tooltip.prese: Cycle through visual display styles (Hearts, Compact, Bar, Numeric, RPG).
shhh-mob-health-indicators.tooltip.posit: Position indicator above or below the mob's nameplate.
shhh-mob-health-indicators.tooltip.heart: Choose between authentic Vanilla pixel-art, Hardcore, or Unicode hearts.
shhh-mob-health-indicators.tooltip.show_: Display golden absorption hearts from effects or golden apples.
Toggle health indicators for monsters and hostile enemies.
Toggle health indicators for animals and peaceful creatures.
Toggle health indicators for bosses (Wither, Warden, Elder Guardian, etc.).
Only show indicators on mobs that have been named with a Name Tag.
shhh-mob-health-indicators.tooltip.hide_: Hide indicators for unharmed mobs at 100% health to reduce clutter.
Hide indicators when mobs have active invisibility status effects.
shhh-mob-health-indicators.tooltip.dista: Maximum distance in blocks to display mob health indicators.
shhh-mob-health-indicators.tooltip.color: Dynamically shift health color from green to red based on remaining HP.
shhh-mob-health-indicators.command.inval: Invalid preset '%s'. Available: hearts, compact, bar, numeric, lifesteal
